title: crm.account.link-sale-products, payload v1 (COMMAND)
description: Step 3 of the SALE saga (ADR-018 §5): link this sale's products to the billing account — the sale's commit point (ADR-013 §8). Destination: crm.account.cmd.link-sale-products.v1. The consumer stores orderNumber as sale_operation_id on every row it creates, which is the ownership key that lets an activation failure undo exactly these rows and nothing else.

orderNumber.description: The sagaId, and the sale_operation_id written onto the involvement rows.

productIds.description: The ids product-service reported. Bulk on purpose — one call per sale, never N — so a partial link set can never be observed (ADR-013 §8.1). Idempotent per (account, product), so a reissued command relinks nothing.
